body:
S22-01 goldenbuild.go: GoldenDocCompiler reads 16 Tier 1 golden docs, compresses each via
claude-haiku bilingual Chinese/English (≤180 tokens/source), writes context/full-system-context.md.
MaybeRebuild checks mtimes — only rebuilds when a source changes.

S22-02 dynamic system prompt: buildEmilySystemPrompt(emilyRoot) reads full-system-context.md and
prepends to static emilyStaticPrompt. 3 call sites updated. Emily Prime now has live cross-repo
northstar context on every conversation turn.

S22-03 cron wiring: MaybeRebuild called at start of RunOnce() in cron.go. CronConfig gets
EmilyRoot field (from EMILY_ROOT env). Context refreshes each 5-min cycle.

S22-04 FABLE full context: fableLoadContext() helper reads full-system-context.md first, falls
back to GOLDEN.md. Both handleFableAdvice and handleFableExecute updated.

S22-06 EMILY/docs/NORTHSTAR.md: Written. 3-agent architecture, cron cycle docs, key files table,
golden context pipeline diagram, revenue context, what "done" looks like.

All: go build + go test pass. CHANGELOG updated.
title: S22 Emily Prime Brain: goldenbuild + dynamic prompt + FABLE full context + NORTHSTAR
